title: MindBridge: A Cross-Subject Brain Decoding Framework
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Reconstruct viewed images for original target subject 7 after adapting a model pretrained on subjects 1, 2 and 5, retaining all Table 2 calibration conditions (500, 1500 and 4000 images). The 4000-image condition is nominated as primary by this design; the paper did not designate a single primary. New target subjects or sessions are extensions.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Reconstruct viewed images for original target subject 7 after adapting a model pretrained on subjects 1, 2 and 5, retaining all Table 2 calibration conditions (500, 1500 and 4000 images). The 4000-image condition is nominated as primary by this design; the paper did not designate a single primary. New target subjects or sessions are extensions.

Source-paper comparison for Table 2 target-subject-7 mean CLIP two-way identification at 4000 calibration images (proportion): Nominated primary is Table 2 target-7 CLIP two-way identification at 4000 calibration images: for predicted image j, fraction of other real-image features with strictly lower Pearson correlation than its true image; average across j. Use source CLIP ViT-L/14 transforms. Retain all eight paper metrics and all three budget conditions; the primary nomination is a benchmark design choice.
success_criteria: Recover and freeze original target-7 test split, all 500/1500/4000 calibration memberships, preprocessing, generation/extractor weights and complete source-subject exposure ledger.
Calibrate authenticated author baselines for all three original Table 2 conditions, pretrained on subjects 1/2/5, using the source best-of-eight target-aware rule under operator-only scoring.
Freeze candidate method, all eight output candidates and resource/access accounting before final source-protocol evaluation; retain the entire original target-7 test set at each budget.

At the nominated 4000-image primary condition, exceed published CLIP 0.925 and a competent matched author rerun by a predeclared meaningful amount with valid paired uncertainty. Report all eight metrics at all three original budgets and predeclare how other budget results constrain any adaptation-efficiency claim.
Do not count a fixed-index protocol, new sessions/splits/calibration subsets, a four-subject Table 1 score or a new curve aggregate as surpassing this original subject-7 task; label these separately.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate using the original source-subject training/development inputs and target-7 calibration access at 500/1500/4000 images. Keep the original target, each full source budget condition and image-prior exposure fixed; do not inspect final test outcomes during iteration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Bind code, hyperparameters, preprocessing, priors, checkpoints, seeds, candidate count, selection evaluator and all final generated images before operator scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: One protected replay on the complete original 982-image target-7 test set at each of 500, 1500 and 4000 calibration images, with unchanged source scoring. The 4000-image CLIP condition is the nominated primary; all other source conditions and metrics remain reported. Exact final replay service is not yet qualified.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep Table 2 published scores (0.867/0.910/0.925 CLIP at 500/1500/4000), authenticated author reruns and candidate scores separate. Table 1 0.947 is a different experiment. The local fixed-index evaluator is calibration/extension infrastructure, not the published baseline. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.
